action_items.note: Acceptance matrix has 7 criteria; produced 8 artifacts total (6 browser checks + 2 backend tests) since criterion 2 (voice/speak TTS) needed a dedicated backend test in addition to being exercised indirectly by the browser audio-instrumentation check.

checks.criterion: USER-REPORTED BUG: JARVIS replies in text but produces no audible speech (createMediaElementSource regression). Orb must stay 'speaking' for several seconds via decodeAudioData + AudioBufferSourceNode, twice in a row.
checks.name: jarvis-voice-speak-works
checks.evidence: Settings > voice test clicked twice. Both times data-orb-state went idle->speaking->idle with duration ~8.5s (8601ms, 8521ms). Web Audio instrumentation: createMediaElementSourceCalls=0 (regression guard), decodeAudioDataCalls=2, startCalls=2. No TTS failure text in error-banner.

checks.criterion: POST /api/voice/speak returns real Turkish Edge-TTS audio
checks.name: test_tscheck_voice_speak.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/voice/speak {text: 'Merhaba, ses testi.'} -> 200, content-type audio/mpeg, body > 5000 bytes (confirmed via curl: real mp3 bytes streamed). POST with empty text -> 422. pytest: 2 passed in 0.92s.

checks.criterion: Mic button enters listening on the FIRST click (previously needed ~3 clicks)
checks.name: mic-first-click-listening
checks.evidence: Fake SpeechRecognition installed that throws on a second concurrent start(). voice-mic-button click -> data-orb-state='listening' immediately, repeated for 3 turns, each single click. Final liveCount=1, instancesCreated=1 (one engine reused throughout, as designed).

checks.criterion: Wake word 'Hey Jarvis' switches into command mode and the dictated command reaches the backend
checks.name: wake-word-triggers-chat-post
checks.evidence: Fake SpeechRecognition emits interim 'hey jarvis' -> orb listening; final 'muzigi ac' -> POST /api/chat (stubbed via page.route) body.text containing 'muzigi ac'. One-breath 'hey jarvis terminalden ls calistir' -> POST body.text === 'terminalden ls calistir' (wake word stripped).

checks.criterion: Rapid clicking the mic button must never wedge the speech engine
checks.name: mic-rapid-click-no-wedge
checks.evidence: 12 rapid clicks on voice-mic-button; fake engine's liveCount stayed <=1 (final liveCount=1, instancesCreated=1), zero page errors, and a subsequent 'hey jarvis' emission still transitioned orb to 'listening'.

checks.criterion: Non-LLM surfaces still work end to end (terminal, metrics, notifications)
checks.name: non-llm-surfaces-work
checks.evidence: metric-cpu/metric-ram show real numeric values (e.g. '%13.6', '12.44 / 31.29 GB'), not dashes. notification-bell opens notification-panel. terminal: 'echo JARVIS_OK_<ts>' shows marker in terminal-output; 'rm -rf /tmp/x' opens terminal-confirm-dialog instead of executing (cancelled, not run). Re-verified on public preview URL.

checks.criterion: A failed LLM turn degrades gracefully instead of crashing or throwing an unhandled rejection
checks.name: chat-llm-failure-graceful
checks.evidence: Sent chat-input message without stubbing /api/chat (real backend, real 502 from exhausted LLM budget). error-banner appeared with Turkish text mentioning 'kredi/bütçe limiti dolmuş'. Navigated to terminal panel afterwards — still interactive. Zero unhandled pageerror events.
